limitations: All lanes formed initial findings before sharing conclusions.
Independent contexts share a model family; agreement is not statistically independent confirmation.
Most system descriptions are documentation or author experiments; no whole-company outcome has been established.
Six consequential current-policy/benchmark assertions received independent primary-source audit; other citations retain their stated source-access and applicability limits.

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L01/L02/L11/L13/L14 distinguish purpose, instructions and continuing promises. Cancellation cannot itself establish that obligations ended.
comparisons.discriminating_question: How does each candidate preserve an obligation absent from its task structure or disputed by a counterparty?

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L02/L10/L13 leave make-versus-buy open. Native business records, professional judgment and supplier evidence have different authority and cost.
comparisons.discriminating_question: Which responsibilities must be owned internally, and when would suppliers or existing domain tools be a better implementation?

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L03/L04/L08 describe useful durable and agent mechanisms; L13 offers records/cases, federation and negotiation; L14 proposes alternative organizing objects. Documentation establishes mechanisms, not a winning whole-company architecture.
comparisons.discriminating_question: What decides the next move, where is its authority enforced, and when does coordination complexity outweigh benefit?

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L05 preserves conditional disagreement between graph-memory and selective flat retrieval results; L13 challenges universal semantics; L14 needs uncertain state without a magical digital twin.
comparisons.discriminating_question: What must share meaning, what stays native, and how can a false or stale belief be corrected without erasing its history?

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L06/L07/L12 distinguish authentic capture, provenance, model explanations, outcome checks and truth. Hidden evaluators can rely on candidate-controlled logging. L13/L14 require an observation boundary.
comparisons.discriminating_question: What can the account prove, what remains outside observation, and how is missing or manipulated evidence detected?

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L07/L08/L10 require authority across retries, provider switching, revocation and aggregate exposure. L11 adds legal principal and continuing duties.
comparisons.status: agreement on invariant; enforcement options open
comparisons.discriminating_question: How can a delayed or restored worker be prevented from acting under obsolete authority, including ambiguous external completion?

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L01/L09/L14 support designed participation but no founder-specific dose is validated. Adaptive learning encounters compete with a transparent fixed rotation. Authority does not establish competence.
comparisons.discriminating_question: How does the owner stay capable without becoming a full-time reviewer or being subjected to opaque personal profiling?

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L10 separates money, provider allowance, execution capacity and attention. L13 counts assurance, coordination and exit costs; L14 proposes closure reserves but does not validate an enterprise dynamics model.
comparisons.discriminating_question: Can complete delivery and responsible termination remain affordable when providers, owner time or suppliers are unavailable?

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L05/L11 require provenance, corrections and selective forgetting, including restored copies. Indefinite personal-data retention is not entailed by truthful history.
comparisons.discriminating_question: How are legally retained facts, erased personal data, unavailable vendor copies and honest reconstruction separated?

comparisons.epistemic_type: Synthesis inference from independently formed reports
comparisons.account: L04/L12 report bounded improvements and model-dependent harness value; L13/L14 require simpler competitors. No evidence authorizes self-expansion of protected policy.
